subject.title: WhatsApp: Add support for querying message reactions

question: Should WhatsApp reactions ship first as passive plugin events only, or should OpenClaw also promise agent-session delivery and persistent historical queries?
rationale: These modes have materially different privacy, routing, retention, storage, and upstream-completeness consequences that repository architecture alone cannot decide.

options.title: Stage passive events first
options.body: Add access-controlled add/remove reaction events without agent turns, leaving historical persistence for a separately approved design.

options.title: Build the complete read path
options.body: Implement passive events, optional agent-session delivery, and SQLite-backed historical queries together with documented retention semantics.

options.title: Retain narrow support
options.body: Keep outbound and registered approval reactions only, declining ordinary reaction observation and history for now.

recommendation.title: Stage passive events first
recommendation.body: Add access-controlled add/remove reaction events without agent turns, leaving historical persistence for a separately approved design.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor has the strongest combined history across WhatsApp routing and the shared approval architecture that already consumes narrow reaction events.
